item.title: Discover sources
item.description:
See which data providers sdmx-dl can connect to, before picking one to query.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.web.*;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager manager = SdmxWebManager.ofServiceLoader();

    manager.getSources().values().stream()
            .filter(source -> !source.isAlias())
            .forEach(source -> IO.println(source.getId()));
}

✅ full support

sdmx-dl list sources

✅ full support

REST 

curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  localhost:4559/sdmx-dl/sources \
  --data "{}"

gRPC 

grpcurl -d '{}' -plaintext localhost:4557 sdmxdl.grpc.SdmxWebManager.GetSources

Notes

  • Some sources are aliases of others (e.g. renamed or mirrored endpoints); the API exposes WebSource.isAlias() to filter them out, while the CLI table lists them alongside their target.

Related features

  • Search sources - find a source when you don’t know its exact ID.
  • Discover flows

item.description:
• Requirements
    • Automatic installation
    • Manual installation

Requirements

sdmx-dl CLI runs on any operating systems that support the Java VM (Virtual Machine) such as Microsoft Windows, Solaris OS, Apple macOS, Ubuntu and other various Linux distributions.

It requires a Java SE Runtime Environment (JRE) version 8 or later to run on such as OpenJDK. You can download a free, binary distribution of the OpenJDK at one of the following provider: Zulu JDK, Adoptium, Amazon Corretto.

item.title: Discover flows
item.description:
See which datasets a source publishes, before picking one to query for data.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.DatabaseRequest;
import sdmxdl.web.SdmxWebManager;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager manager = SdmxWebManager.ofServiceLoader();

    manager.usingName("ECB")
            .listFlows(DatabaseRequest.DEFAULT)
            .forEach(flow -> IO.println(flow.getRef()));
}

✅ full support

sdmx-dl list flows ECB

✅ full support

REST 

curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  localhost:4559/sdmx-dl/flows \
  --data "{\"source\":\"ECB\"}"

gRPC 

grpcurl -d '{"source":"ECB"}' -plaintext localhost:4557 sdmxdl.grpc.SdmxWebManager.GetFlows

Notes

  • Some sources expose several databases; pass a database to scope the listing (defaults to the source’s single/default database otherwise).

Related features

  • Discover sources
  • Search flows - find a flow by topic when you don’t know its exact ID.

item.title: Search sources
item.description:
Find a source by name or topic when you don’t know its exact ID, with typo tolerance.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.Languages;
import sdmxdl.web.*;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager manager = SdmxWebManager.ofServiceLoader();

    Search<WebSource> search = Search.ofSources(manager.getSources().values(), Languages.ANY);
    search.search("european central", 5)
            .forEach(result -> IO.println(result.getItem().getId()));
}

✅ full support

sdmx-dl search sources "european central" -n 5

✅ full support

item.title: Usage
item.description:
By default, all commands print the result on the standard output.
Most commands produce RFC4180 compliant CSV content.

Command arguments are composed of options and positional parameters. Options have a name, positional parameters are usually the values that follow the options, but they may be mixed. The general pattern is:

sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A -o chf.csv
         command         parameters          options

All commands share the following options:

  • -h, --help - Show an help message and exit.
  • -v, --verbose - Enable verbose mode.

Commands summary

The commands follow a verb+noun hierarchy.

item.title: Options
item.description:
An option has the following caracteristics:

  • it has a name prefixed by two hyphens (e.g. --version).
  • it may have a shortcut prefixed by one hyphen (e.g. -h is a shortcut of --help).
  • it is case-sensitive

Shortcuts can be grouped behind one hyphen (e.g. -vh is equivalent to -v -h).

The options default values are system-independent.

Common

General-purpose options used by various commands.

item.title: Search flows
item.description:
Find a dataset by topic within a source when you don’t know its exact flow ID.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.*;
import sdmxdl.web.*;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager manager = SdmxWebManager.ofServiceLoader();

    var flows = manager.usingName("ECB").listFlows(DatabaseRequest.DEFAULT);

    Search<Flow> search = Search.ofFlows(flows);
    search.search("exchange rates", 5)
            .forEach(result -> IO.println(result.getItem().getRef() + " -> " + result.getScore()));
}

item.title: Examples
item.description:
1. Download monthly (M) exchange rates (EXR) of Swiss franc (CHF) from the European Central Bank (ECB) 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A
  2. Same as 1 with saving into a file 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A -o filename.csv
  3. Same as 1 with saving into a compressed file 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A -o filename.csv.gz -z
  4. Same as 1 with displaying as human-readable table (PowerShell example) 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A | ConvertFrom-Csv | Select-Object -First 3 | Format-Table
    Series           ObsAttributes ObsPeriod           ObsValue
------           ------------- ---------           --------
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A OBS_STATUS=A  1999-01-01T00:00:00 1.605495
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A OBS_STATUS=A  1999-02-01T00:00:00 1.59785
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A OBS_STATUS=A  1999-03-01T00:00:00 1.595430434782609
  5. Same as 1 with displaying as human-readable table (xsv example) 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A | xsv slice -l 3 | xsv table
    Series            ObsAttributes  ObsPeriod            ObsValue
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A  OBS_STATUS=A   1999-01-01T00:00:00  1.605495
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A  OBS_STATUS=A   1999-02-01T00:00:00  1.59785
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A  OBS_STATUS=A   1999-03-01T00:00:00  1.595430434782609
  6. Same as 1 with displaying as human-readable table (Miller example) 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A | mlr --c2p head -n 3 
    Series           ObsAttributes           ObsPeriod           ObsValue
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A OBS_STATUS=A,OBS_CONF=F 1999-01-01T00:00:00 1.605495
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A OBS_STATUS=A,OBS_CONF=F 1999-02-01T00:00:00 1.59785
M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A OBS_STATUS=A,OBS_CONF=F 1999-03-01T00:00:00 1.5954304347826
  7. Same as 1 with US dollar (USD) alongside Swiss franc 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF+USD.EUR.SP00.A
  8. Same as 1 for every available currencies 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M..EUR.SP00.A
  9. Download available series in a dataset 
    sdmx-dl fetch keys ECB EXR .CHF.EUR.SP00.A
  10. Same as 1 but only from 2020 onwards 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A --start 2020
  11. Same as 1 but only within a time range 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A --start 2020 --end 2022-12
  12. Same as 1 but only the last 3 observations 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A --last-n 3
  13. Same as 1 but the first 3 and the last 2 observations 
    sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A --first-n 3 --last-n 2
  1. List available datasets from the European Central Bank (ECB) 
    sdmx-dl list flows ECB
  2. List dimensions of the exchange rates (EXR) 
    sdmx-dl list dimensions ECB EXR
  3. List codes of the frequency dimension (FREQ) 
    sdmx-dl list codes ECB EXR FREQ

item.title: Inspect metadata
item.description:
Look up descriptive metadata (title, units, notes, source-specific attributes) attached to a series or a flow, without downloading the observations themselves.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.*;
import sdmxdl.web.SdmxWebManager;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager
            .ofServiceLoader()
            .usingName("ECB")
            .getData(KeyRequest.builder()
                    .flowOf("EXR")
                    .keyOf("M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A")
                    .detailOf(Detail.NO_DATA.name())
                    .build())
            .forEach(series -> series.getMeta().forEach((concept, value) ->
                    IO.println(concept + " = " + value)));
}

✅ full support

item.title: Browse codes
item.description:
Look up the human-readable labels behind a coded dimension’s values (e.g. FREQ=M means “Monthly”), so you can build a valid key or interpret one.

⚠️ partial support — Via metadata traversal (Dimension.getCodes()), not a dedicated call.

Not supported as a dedicated high-level API call.

The closest API equivalent is to retrieve flow metadata and inspect the codes attached to a coded dimension.

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.*;
import sdmxdl.web.SdmxWebManager;

void main() throws Exception {
    try (Connection conn = SdmxWebManager.ofServiceLoader().getConnection("ECB", Languages.ANY)) {
        MetaSet meta = conn.getMeta(DatabaseRef.NO_DATABASE, FlowRef.parse("EXR"));
        Dimension freq = meta.getStructure().getDimensions().stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getId().equals("FREQ"))
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow();
        freq.getCodes().forEach((code, label) -> IO.println(code + " = " + label));
    }
}

✅ full support

item.title: Check availability
item.description:
Narrow down which codes are actually usable for one dimension, once other dimensions of the key are already fixed — useful for building valid keys interactively instead of guessing.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.*;
import sdmxdl.web.SdmxWebManager;

void main() throws Exception {
    try (Connection conn = SdmxWebManager.ofServiceLoader().getConnection("ECB", Languages.ANY)) {
        conn.getAvailableDimensionCodes(DatabaseRef.NO_DATABASE, FlowRef.parse("EXR"), Key.parse("M..EUR.SP00.A"), 1)
                .forEach(IO::println);
    }
}

✅ full support

item.title: Narrow your request
item.description:
Restrict a data request to a date range and/or a limited number of observations, so you download only what you need instead of a series’ full history.

Both narrowing mechanisms are just extra fields on the same data request (KeyRequest/Query in the API, options on fetch data in the CLI, fields on GetData in the WS), so they can be used separately or together.

By period

✅ full support

item.title: Retrieve data
item.description:
Download observations from a dataset using a source, flow, and key.

✅ full support

//JAVA 25+
//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.KeyRequest;
import sdmxdl.web.SdmxWebManager;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager
            .ofServiceLoader()
            .usingName("ECB")
            .getData(KeyRequest.builder()
                    .flowOf("EXR")
                    .keyOf("M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A")
                    .startPeriodOf("2020")
                    .endPeriodOf("2022-12")
                    .lastNObservations(3)
                    .build())
            .forEach(series -> IO.println(series.getKey()));
}

item.title: Authentication and credentials
item.description:
Configure how sdmx-dl authenticates against protected data sources — credentials are configured once, in a source config file shared by every flavor.

✅ full support

sdmxdl.driver.authScheme=BASIC

For OAuth2/Msal-backed sources, the same source configuration can also define:

sdmxdl.authenticator.clientId=...
sdmxdl.authenticator.authority=...
sdmxdl.authenticator.scopes=...

✅ full support

The CLI reads the same source configuration file, so the same authentication properties apply when running commands such as:

sdmx-dl fetch data ECB EXR M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A --sources sources.csv

✅ full support

item.title: Output and formats
item.description:
Pick the right output for your use case: Java objects for the library, CSV for shell pipelines, or JSON/protobuf for a remote service.

✅ full support

The API is object-centric and can be used with the supported format modules and managers. A common entry point is the Java library or the standalone JAR distribution.

//DEPS com.github.nbbrd.sdmx-dl:sdmx-dl-standalone:3.2.0
import sdmxdl.KeyRequest;
import sdmxdl.web.SdmxWebManager;

void main() throws Exception {
    SdmxWebManager
            .ofServiceLoader()
            .usingName("ECB")
            .getData(KeyRequest.builder()
                    .flowOf("EXR")
                    .keyOf("M.CHF.EUR.SP00.A")
                    .build())
            .forEach(series -> IO.println(series.getKey()));
}

✅ full support
